scripts.predev:api: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-port.ps1 -Port 50003 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-port.ps1 -Port 50004 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-port.ps1 -Port 50005
scripts.dev:mobile: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-port.ps1 -Port 50018 && npm run dev --workspace=@are/mobile
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose run --rm api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:downgrade: docker compose run --rm api alembic downgrade -1
scripts.backend:format: docker compose run --rm api ruff format --check .
scripts.backend:lint: docker compose run --rm api ruff check .
scripts.backend:typecheck: docker compose run --rm api mypy app
scripts.projects:import:load: docker compose run --rm api python -m app.project_acquisition_cli load
scripts.projects:acquire: docker compose run --rm api python -m app.project_acquisition_cli acquire
scripts.projects:refresh: docker compose run --rm api python -m app.project_acquisition_cli refresh
scripts.projects:retry-failed: docker compose run --rm api python -m app.project_acquisition_cli retry-failed
scripts.projects:import:status: docker compose run --rm api python -m app.project_acquisition_cli status
